notes: Benchmark-derived skill vector, recalibrated 2026-07-14 by a 5-model council (one web-research agent per Claude model) then cross-model reconciled. Sourcing per dimension: coding=SWE-bench Verified (standard mode 60.6%); instruction_following=IFBench 54.3% + MMLU-Pro 80%; math_reasoning=AIME 2025 (standard, no tools); world_knowledge=GPQA Diamond (standard 60.5%); planning_agentic=tau2-bench standard mode; creative_synthesis=imputed (no clean public benchmark). Standard-mode (non-extended-thinking) figures used for cross-model comparability, then the whole 5-model matrix was rescaled to widen tier separation for routing (haiku is the cheapest/floor tier). Haiku 4.5 does not support reasoning effort. A `measured` extraction on the frozen probe set overrides this. See README.md.
